mainEntity.name: What is included in the desert safari tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The evening desert safari includes dune bashing with professional drivers, camel ride, falcon photography, henna tattoo, shisha lounge, and authentic Bedouin BBQ dinner with live entertainment. Hotel pickup and drop-off are also included.

mainEntity.name: How long does the desert safari tour take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The entire tour takes approximately 6 hours, starting with hotel pickup around 2:30 PM and returning to your hotel by 9:00 PM. Exact timing depends on your hotel location.

mainEntity.name: What is the price for the desert safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: The desert safari evening tour costs AED 175 per person (approximately USD 48). Children under 5 are free, and there are discounts available for group bookings of 10 or more people.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to bring anything for the desert safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend bringing sunscreen, sunglasses, a light jacket (for evening chill), and a camera. Wear comfortable clothing and closed shoes. We provide all necessary equipment and refreshments.

mainEntity.name: Is the desert safari suitable for families with children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! The desert safari is family-friendly. Children can enjoy dune bashing (not too extreme), camel rides, henna tattoos, and the dinner. We offer private tours for families who prefer a more personalized experience.

mainEntity.name: Can I book the desert safari online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can book online at www.example.com/booking. We require payment upfront to secure your reservation. Cancellations up to 24 hours before the tour receive a full refund.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the weather is bad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Desert safaris operate in most weather conditions. In case of extreme weather, we offer a full refund or reschedule your tour to another date at no additional cost.

mainEntity.name: Are dietary requirements accommodated at dinner?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we accommodate vegetarian, vegan, and other dietary requirements. Please inform us at the time of booking, and we will ensure appropriate meal options are available.
